episodes.overview: After hearing about the accident Yong-ho was in, Bang-geul rushes to the hospital and runs into Yong-ho in Jun-hyeon’s body. Yong-ho is accused of being the hit-and-run driver and faces a fierce public backlash, while Jae-gyeong seizes the opportunity to force him out of the chairman position for good. Jun-hyeon joins Choiseong Group as an intern.

episodes.name: Proving Your Competency
episodes.overview: Determined to help Bang-geul, Yong Ho sets out in Jun-hyeon's body to uncover the twins' hidden stash of illicit funds. As the twins compete for the position of the next Chairman, they quietly carry out their own schemes behind the scenes. Jun-hyeon's grandmother sets off for Seoul to find her grandson. When Bang-geul learns of her disappearance by chance, she joins the search and helps track her down.

episodes.name: A Divide And Conquer Strategy
episodes.overview: The disappearance of Managing Director Song becomes the subject of a police investigation, putting Jae-seong in a difficult position. Yong-ho realises that Jae-seong intends to sabotage the port project for  Taeha's benefit, his father-in-law's company. Yong-ho sides with Jae-gyeong and shares everything he knows, deepening the twins' mistrust of one another.

episodes.name: A Self-Destructive Battle
episodes.overview: Chairman Na insists that GF Solution must be acquired and assures Jae-seong that Taeha will back the deal financially if needed. Yong-ho manipulates both Jae-gyeong and Jae-seong into driving up the acquisition price to an absurd level. Meanwhile, Yong-ho reveals to Sang-jae that he is Yong-ho, now living inside Jun-hyeon's body.

episodes.name: The Claws Are Out At Last
episodes.overview: Yong-ho, Bang-geul, and Bong-gi travel to Yulivia to steal the mining project Taeha has been working on. They figure out Chairman Na’s scheme against Yulivia’s government. Seon-hee finds out that Jae-gyeong and her husband have been sedating Yong-ho to keep him from waking up. After learning about this, Yong-ho and Bang-geul decide to reveal themselves to the board of directors.

episodes.name: War Is Declared
episodes.overview: Determined to stand by Bang-geul, Seon-hee declares war on Jae-gyeong and the family, pledging to support her with all her might. Jae-gyeong figures out that Bang-geul and Jun-hyeon are behind Smile Investment. Meanwhile, Chairman Na meets Jae-gyeong and suggests getting rid of Bang-geul for her.

episodes.name: Making Another Sacrifice
episodes.overview: After successfully getting rid of Jae-seong, Jae-gyeong sets Managing Director Lee up and accuses him of trying to take over Choiseong. She calls an emergency board meeting and makes Bang-geul and Jun-hyeon fire 20 percent of the staff. In the meantime, she also makes a secret deal with Chairman Na.

episodes.name: Deep In Enemy Territory
episodes.overview: After Chairman Kang’s death, Jae-gyeong openly moves to take over Choiseong Group. She also frames Seon-hee and Bang-geul for Chairman Kang’s alleged creation of slush funds. Determined to take Jae-gyeong down, Yong-ho pretends to betray Bang-geul and joins Jae-gyeong’s side.

episodes.name: Betrayal Upon Betrayal
episodes.overview: Jae-gyeong finds herself on the verge of losing the Daesan Hydrogen Complex to Chairman Na under highly unfavourable terms. Realising that Jae-gyeong is being blackmailed by Chairman Na, Yong-ho pretends to join forces with Chairman Na and ultimately discovers that Jae-gyeong was not the one who killed him. Meanwhile, Bang-geul learns that Yong-ho has sided with Taeha and begins following him to uncover the truth.

episodes.name: Getting Proper Revenge
episodes.overview: Bang-geul finds out who actually killed her dad and swears to take revenge on them. Yong-ho gives the CCTV footage from the hospital to Jae-gyeong, and she uses it to blackmail Chairman Na. Eun-se flies to Singapore to get Chairman Na’s slush fund, but unexpected news hits her while she’s there.

episodes.name: The Final Punishment
episodes.overview: Yong-ho finally wakes up in his body and saves Jun-hyeon, who was in danger because of Chairman Na. Yong-ho asks Jae-gyeong to make things right with him, but she refuses. Jae-seong turns himself in and reveals everything he did with Jae-gyeong.

series.name: Notes from the Last Row
aka: El chico de la última fila
บันทึกจากหลังห้อง
Những ghi chú ở hàng cuối
series.overview: Un professeur de littérature coréenne à l'université est rongé depuis sa jeunesse de ne pas avoir réussi une carrière d'écrivain. Il va être surpris par les talents d'écriture d'un étudiant en ingénierie qui assiste à ses cours. Son intérêt pour le jeune homme va raviver sa passion pour l'écriture, mais aussi développer une obsession pour l'œuvre de ce dernier.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Impressionné par le talent de son étudiant, le professeur Heo Mun-oh lui propose un cours particulier d'écriture, mais une demande troublante met sa déontologie à l'épreuve.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: L'histoire de Kang commence par une rencontre fortuite avec son camarade Kim Se-yun. Alors que Mun-oh doute des motivations de Kang, un accident révèle une vérité choquante.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Mun-oh commence à faire une fixation sur l'histoire lorsque des accusations circulent sur le père de Se-yun. Les recherches de Kang le conduisent sur les traces de quelqu'un.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Les soupçons grandissent à mesure que Kang poursuit ses observations. Mun-oh hésite à l'empêcher d'écrire. Plus tard, une lettre conduit Kang à un rendez-vous nocturne.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Alors que l'histoire de Kang s'achève sur une fausse fin, Mun-oh attend déjà la suite avec impatience. La mère de Se-yun fait un choix désespéré pour protéger sa famille.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Tandis que Kang continue de repousser les limites au nom de son art, Mun-oh est désormais obsédé par ses écrits, et tous deux s'approchent du point de non-retour.

series.name: Love in Sync
aka: ใจเชื่อมรัก
series.overview:
Yoo Ji-An est une femme qui rejette l'empathie, tandis que Cha Eun Hwan est un homme qui en est accablé.

Lorsqu'ils commencent à partager leurs émotions l'un avec l'autre à la suite d'un phénomène inattendu,

ils se lancent dans un parcours d'apprentissage.

episodes.name: First Encounter
episodes.overview: Top star Jian seeks out counselor Eunhwan, only to confront a forgotten past during their session.

episodes.name: Ji-an’s Downfall
episodes.overview: Disgraced Jian meets broken counselor Eunhwan. Soon after, she begins hearing a strange voice.

episodes.name: Attempt To Comeback
episodes.overview: Jian and Eunhwan become neighbors. One day, Jian discovers the emotions he has long kept buried.

episodes.name: Proposal To Eun-hwan
episodes.overview: Jian, changed by new emotions, gains attention and makes an unexpected proposal to Eunhwan.

episodes.name: New Manager
episodes.overview: By Eunhwan, Jian begins acting again. But when she falls once more, he makes a shocking declaration.

episodes.name: Audition
episodes.overview: As the two uncover a hidden secret, a connection tied to a past accident begins to surface.

episodes.name: Reveals The Truth
episodes.overview: The two finally confirm each other's feelings. But another incident hits Jian.

episodes.name: Disappearance
episodes.overview: A buried truth tears them apart, forcing Jian and Eunhwan to face their true feelings.

series.name: Dream to You
aka: เติมฝันในใจเธอ
君へと続く僕のドリーム
series.overview: Rêvant de devenir cinéaste, une lycéenne passionnée délaisse toutes ses obligations pour réaliser des courts-métrages, inspirant ainsi un camarade de classe studieux mais dépourvu de passion. Leur profonde complicité finit par se transformer en histoire d’amour, mais ils sont brutalement séparés lorsque le jeune homme est contraint de partir vivre à l’étranger. Des années plus tard, alors qu’ils ont tous deux atteint la trentaine, leurs vies se sont complètement inversées : elle est devenue une journaliste de télévision désabusée et en difficulté, tandis que lui s’est imposé comme un réalisateur primé. Lorsqu’une rencontre fortuite les réunit soudainement, il décide de l’aider à retrouver l’étincelle qu’elle a perdue. Mais elle nourrit toujours un profond ressentiment envers lui, à cause de sa disparition soudaine des années auparavant.

episodes.name: Su-bin’s Return
episodes.overview: Woo Su-bin, a new director, wins an award at an international film festival. During his acceptance speech, he thanks his first love for giving him a dream. After the festival, he visits Korea to meet his first love, Joo Yi-jae, who wanted to become a director but works as a reporter.

episodes.name: Their Past And Present
episodes.overview: During their senior year of high school, Yi-jae is an aspiring amateur filmmaker. Su-bin also decides to become a director after helping Yi-jae and spending time with her. Although Yi-jae wins an award at a youth film festival, her family fails to show up.

episodes.name: A New Bond And A Broken Bond
episodes.overview: Yi-jae travels to her hometown to meet and cast Su-bin. As they spend time together, they share a deep conversation about their past. However, when Su-bin reveals his hidden history, Yi-jae responds with sarcasm, finding him pathetic.

episodes.name: The Contract
episodes.overview: After mulling it over, Yi-jae finally makes a contract with Su-bin, and they move to Bunam to write the script for Gyeongseong Love Song. Working together, Yi-jae’s feelings towards him begin to grow despite herself. Meanwhile, Ha-na protects Yu-geon from Sang-yeon.

episodes.name: The Truth
episodes.overview: After spending a night with Sa-rang, In-wook decides to appear on her show because he wants to keep the relationship with her. Yu-geon saves Ha-na from people putting her down, and they open up about their inner wounds and dreams. Meanwhile, Su-bin and Yi-jae’s relationship grows steadily as their work goes well.

episodes.name: The Pre-Production Of Gyeongseong Love Song
episodes.overview: Su-bin tries to help Yi-jae in every way after learning about her accident. Therefore, when pre-production for Gyeongseong Love Song begins, Su-bin goes on location scouting and Yi-jae stays indoors for the script meeting. However, it makes Yi-jae feel like she is not approved by the crew because of Su-bin’s overprotection.

episodes.name: Ha-na’s Decision
episodes.overview: Su-bin and Yi-jae reunite to work together on a new project. Upon learning that Yu-geon is now working alongside Soo-hee, Su-bin can't hide a hint of disappointment, while Yi-jae reacts in a way no one expects. Meanwhile, Ha-na is hurt when Yu-geon begins to distance himself from her.

episodes.name: Chaos During Filming On Set
episodes.overview: Filming for Su-bin and Yi-jae’s movie finally begins, but chaos erupts when Soo-hee suddenly shows up on set and causes a scene. The situation escalates to the point where replacing the male lead is even brought up. Meanwhile, Ha-na gives up her rebellion against Soo-hee and decides to renew her contract with her.

episodes.name: A Connection That Goes Way Back
episodes.overview: Su-bin gets extremely jealous when Seong-moo appears on set and shows how close he is to Yi-jae. The Gyeongseong Love Song crew decides to go on a retreat, and Seong-moo joins as well. From dodgeball to grilling meat, the competition between Su-bin and Seong-moo gets fierce.

episodes.name: Confronting The Truth
episodes.overview: News breaks that Su-bin is Ha-na's half-sibling, and reporters flock to the filming location. Due to the scandal, Yi-jae has to handle the movie shoot all by herself. However, the production comes to a halt due to investment issues.

episodes.name: Achieving One’s Dream
episodes.overview: Su-bin tells Yi-jae that he’ll drop out of the movie production so that it can proceed smoothly. Yi-jae convinces CEO Ahn to reconsider firing Su-bin. Yi-jae wants to study film abroad, but she struggles to tell Su-bin about it.

episodes.name: The End Of A Love Like War
episodes.overview: Yi-jae leaves for Montreal to study film in greater depth. Su-bin goes to the airport to stop her, but he misses her. Gyeongseong Love Song gets released successfully, but Su-bin can’t help but feel empty.

series.name: Doctor on the Edge
aka: 孤島のエリートドクター
หมอติดเกาะรักติดเธอ
El médico del fin del mundo
series.overview: Do Jiui, chirurgien plasticien, est promis à un brillant avenir, lorsqu'une affectation comme médecin de santé publique sur l'île isolée de Pyeondongdo vient bouleverser sa vie. Pour Jiui, cet endroit perdu au milieu de l'océan est plus qu'un simple exil. Hanté par un traumatisme, la mer est pour lui une source de terreur, une prison à ciel ouvert. Entre les habitants indiscrets et les insectes qui l'assaillent de toutes parts, la vie sur l'île est un véritable enfer pour ce citadin. C'est là qu'il rencontre l'infirmière mystérieuse, Yuk Hari. Derrière un doux sourire lourd de secrets, elle semble toujours là lorsque la phobie de Jiui refait surface. Alors que leurs chemins ne cessent de se croiser, Jiui parviendra-t-il à surmonter ses peurs et à quitter l'île ?

episodes.name: The Doctor Sent to the Island
episodes.overview: Dreading his post, Do Jiui arrives on Pyeondongdo, meets Yuk Hari, and begins harsh island life.

episodes.name: The Woman Who Crosses the Line
episodes.overview: Do Jiui meets the mysterious nurse Yuk Hari, and their line-crossing house calls begin.

episodes.name: Getting Through Another Day
episodes.overview: The village chief makes Jiui an outcast. Meanwhile, Hari and Chiyeon are stranded overnight.

episodes.name: A Notorious Woman, a Pathetic Man
episodes.overview: Jiui is shaken by Hari's past and rumors, and a storm-hit emergency leaves him paralyzed by trauma.

episodes.name: Pyeondong Scandal
episodes.overview: Hari nurses Jiui amidst hospital gossip. Meanwhile, on Pyeondongdo, Mija is in critical condition.

episodes.name: An Unspeakable Secret
episodes.overview: Jiui and Hari's relationship is tested by Mija as the county governor schemes over Deokhwa's rescue.

episodes.name: Words Left Unsaid
episodes.overview: Torn between love and hurt, Jiui and the hurt Hari drift apart, and Mija's condition worsens.

episodes.name: I Can't Do It. I Can't Ignore You.
episodes.overview: Grieving her grandma, a downpour forces Hari to live with Jiui. Amid mix emotions, a secret emerges.

episodes.name: Courage to Forgive
episodes.overview: Jiui and Hari confirm their feelings, illness spreads on Jineondo, and a man appears before Jucheon.

episodes.name: It's Not Okay
episodes.overview: A crash shatters Jiui. As his first love Hwayeong returns, Hari must decide whether to let him go.

episodes.name: Reconciliation, Healing, And...
episodes.overview: Amid a confession and a breakup ahead, a misdiagnosed case returns, and Jiui stands at a crossroads.

episodes.name: If I Just Tough It Out, Things Will Work Out Somehow!
episodes.overview: The governor's risky deal could save the public health center. Will Jiui resist or compromise?

series.name: Agent Kim Reactivated
aka: สายลับคิมกลับมาแล้ว
Đặc Vụ Kim Tái Khởi Động
エージェント・キム：リアクティベーティッド
series.overview: Quand sa fille disparaît, un père en apparence sans histoire retrouve ses qualités d'agent secret pour la retrouver — et s'attire des ennuis.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Employé de banque ordinaire, Kim n'a de plus grand souci que de nouer de meilleurs liens avec sa fille, Kim Min-ji… jusqu’à ce que celle-ci disparaisse soudainement.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Prêt à tout pour retrouver Min-ji, Kim, un manager ordinaire, mise sur ses talents passés d'agent secret spécialisé dans l'élimination radicale de cibles ennemies.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Kim reprend contact avec Sung Han-soo et Park Jin-cheol, ses amis pères de famille (et anciens agents secrets), pour retrouver Min-ji.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Les actes risqués de Kim attirent l'attention d'ennemis, anciens et actuels. Quand le danger surgit, Han-soo et Jin-cheol lui prêtent main forte.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: L'agent Kim affronte son poursuivant avant de se rendre compte qu'il s'agit d'une connaissance venue tout droit de son passé. Min-ji tente de s'échapper par ses propres moyens.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Min-ji se retrouve dans une situation désespérée, jusqu'à l'intervention de l'agente spéciale Jung Sang-a. La Direction des forces spéciales essaie d'appâter l'agent Kim.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Kim et Min-ji se retrouvent enfin, mais leur parcours pour se mettre en sécurité est semé d'embûches. Kim est finalement obligé de prendre une décision difficile.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Kim est capturé et torturé, jusqu'à ce que la Direction des forces spéciales n'intervienne pour lui confier une dernière mission. Ju Gang-chan planifie sa vengeance.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: La mission de Kim ayant échoué, les trois pères agents font équipe avec Sang-a pour se tirer d'affaire. Mais Gang-chan a plus d'un tour dans son sac.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Acculé par Gang-chan, l'agent Kim doit prendre une décision cruciale, de même que Han-soo et Jin-cheol. Parviendra-t-il à assurer la sécurité de Min-ji ?

series.name: In Your Radiant Season
series.overview: Chan vit chaque jour comme si c'était les vacances d'été. Haran, quant à elle, est prisonnière d'un hiver solitaire. Lorsque leur passé oublié les réunit, Chan est déterminé à lui offrir un nouveau printemps. À travers rires et larmes, ils affrontent l'hiver ensemble et retrouvent enfin le printemps dans cette romance touchante.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Seven years after a lab explosion, Chan returns home for work and unexpectedly meets Haran again.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Chan sees that Haran is frozen in winter and suggests a three-month trial friendship.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Haran rejects Chan's three-month friendship offer, but Chan is undeterred.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: As Chan and Haran grow closer, a mysterious sound begins to haunt him, revealing gaps in his memory.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Chan and Ha-ran find a Gyeongju escape but a resurfacing memory puts Chan in a brewing storm. Unbeknownst to Ha-ran, Chan is drawn into a brewing storm.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Chan's sudden exit for the U.S. leaves Ha-ran reeling. As longing sets in, the three sisters clash and Na-na faces an unexpected incident.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Chan and Ha-ran reunite after his U.S. return. At a SHIM party, their bond grows while Chan starts recording his resurfacing memories.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Ha-ran helps Chan reveal his father's watch secret. After their reconciliation, Ha-ran wins an award but meets a shocking face at the ceremony.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Chan's unintentional lie about the fountain pen weighs on his conscience. To stay close to Ha-ran, he must decide if the truth is worth the risk.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Chan's envy of Su-jin and Ha-ran grows. As Ha-ran celebrates Chan’s birthday, she moves past her "winter" while Nana makes a choice in Chuncheon.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: Ha-ran, who learns Chan's secret from seven years ago through the "1-Inch of Memory" notebook, falls into confusion upon realizing that even the fountain pen was a gift he had prepared.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: After their trial ends, Haran learns the truth. Chan has vanished, but discovering his feelings, she goes to find him.

series.name: Absolute Value of Romance
aka: วุ่นนัก รักสัมบูรณ์
Giá trị tuyệt đối của lãng mạn
series.overview: La lycéenne Yeo Eui-ju écrit secrètement des romans sur Internet la nuit. Lorsque quatre charmants nouveaux professeurs arrivent, ils lui inspirent des histoires et bouleversent son école. Une romance pleine d'esprit sur les rêves d'adolescents, les moments maladroits et le passage à l'âge adulte.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Eui-ju is a quiet student by day and a bold romance writer by night. Her future seems uncertain as the man she wronged becomes her homeroom teacher.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: A sweet scene between teachers ignites Eui-ju's creativity. She casts them as leads in her new novel. During PE class, Gi-jeon makes her heart skip.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Eui-ju hides Woo-su's glasses after stepping on them by mistake. Given his demerits and tough task, she trashes them, thinking he's picking on her.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Once she realizes the glasses were special, Eui-ju digs them out of the trash but still gets a detention. She posts her F4-inspired web novel online.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: We Were Friends" goes viral. Riding the high, Eui-ju writes the steamiest cliffhanger yet, unaware someone is standing right behind her.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Woo-su demands she delete everything. Now forced to write the novel on his terms, Eui-ju hits a wall. Meanwhile, the principal has plans of her own.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: On the EBC filming day, Da-ju urges Eui-ju to film Woo-su's class secretly, but she gets caught. She collapses and Woo-su carries her to the hospital.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Eui-ju wonders why Woo-su allows her to keep writing her novel. One offhand remark from him sets her heart racing.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: As Eui-ju denies Woo-su's words made her flutter, a Fields Medal winner visits him. Misunderstood as liking Dong-ju, Eui-ju grows awkward with Go-ya.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Feeling inadequate, Eui-ju writes Deul-i as a villain in her novel. Woo-su considers a research proposal in the US, and the prospect makes Eui-ju sad.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: Ji-a is captured by loan sharks. Woo-su gets in trouble trying to rescue her. Just as things look hopeless, someone arrives to save them both.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: Dong-ju's secret is revealed. Eui-ju reconciles with Go-ya, and encouraged by her advice, decides to confess feelings.

episodes.name: Épisode 13
episodes.overview: Eui-ju's hesitant to confess. She realizes she's just a student to Woo-su. When Ha-su discovers her novel, her heart races with fear of being exposed.

episodes.name: Épisode 14
episodes.overview: The entire school finds out about the novel. Word reaches Young-hee, and Eui-ju must bring her parents to school. She tells her parents the truth.

episodes.name: Épisode 15
episodes.overview: Eui-ju is crushed after seeing how well Woo-su treats Deul-i at her guest lecture. After class, Eui-ju poses a life-defining math problem to Woo-su.

episodes.name: Épisode 16
episodes.overview: Eui-ju rushes to the hospital after hearing that Woo-su had eye surgery. She finally learns the truth behind the promise made ten years ago.

series.name: The WONDERfools
aka: The WONDERfools: คนมหัศจรรย์พลังรั่ว
series.overview: Dans cette série d'action déjantée, une bande de bras cassés du coin se découvre des super-pouvoirs et lutte contre le mal sur fond de panique apocalyptique.

episodes.name: À chaque vie son coup de théâtre
episodes.overview: Quand des rumeurs d'apocalypse se répandent à travers Haeseong, une jeune femme en phase terminale sans le sou élabore un kidnapping avec deux acolytes maladroits.

episodes.name: Les secrets doivent être bien gardés
episodes.overview: Eun Chae-ni et ses amis insolites Son Gyeong-hun et Kang Ro-bin sont déroutés par leurs nouvelles habiletés. Un Lee Un-jeong méfiant affronte ses doutes.

episodes.name: Les brutes et les déboires affluent
episodes.overview: La bande est témoin du superpouvoir d'Un-jeong lors d'une crise. Les héros sont fous de joie après un sauvetage audacieux, mais Un-jeong ressent la présence d'un danger tout près.

episodes.name: Hibou le Kinder contre les Wunderkinder
episodes.overview: Le Dr Ha Won-do est de retour après 20 ans, à la recherche des secrets de l'enfant de l'éternité. La bande est toujours incertaine quant à ses pouvoirs et affronte une attaque.

episodes.name: Tu es tout pour nous
episodes.overview: Un-jeong mène un camp d'entraînement afin que la bande maîtrise ses habiletés. Chae-ni affronte sa grand-mère au sujet du secret de ses pouvoirs.

episodes.name: Tous les chemins mènent à Chae-ni
episodes.overview: Chae-ni a un éveil brutal, mais trouve un miracle dans sa poche. Un-jeong passe en mode planification avec Gyeong-hun et Ro-bin afin de secourir Chae-ni.

episodes.name: Les Gardiens de Haeseong Partie 1
episodes.overview: Un-jeong et la bande affrontent d'autres fidèles dotés de super pouvoirs, alors que le plan risqué du Dr Ha cible Chae-ni.

episodes.name: Les Gardiens de Haeseong Partie 2
episodes.overview: 1999. La veille du Nouvel An. Trois marginaux utilisent leurs habiletés afin d'affronter des méchants dotés de super pouvoirs lors d'une guerre totale dans la ville de Haeseong.

series.name: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
aka: 伝説のキッチン・ソルジャー
บันทึกครัวค่ายทหาร
Anh Nuôi - Thăng Cấp Thành Huyền Thoại
La leyenda del cocinero del ejército
伝説のキッチンソルジャー
The Military Cook Becomes a Legend

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Seong-jae enlists in the army as a cook and receives mysterious game-like commands that appear only to him.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Facing reassignment, Seong-jae must complete a high-stakes cooking quest within 72 hours to secure his role as military cook.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Seong-jae must improvise a daring dish during a surprise inspection to save his military kitchen.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Seong-jae's culinary success lifts unit morale but triggers professional jealousy and tension after an unexpected encounter.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Stripped of his skills while on leave, Seong-jae works as a kitchen assistant to save his mother's business and discovers a secret ingredient.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Seong-jae rallies the troops with an improvised arancini, but encounters danger after overhearing Captain Lee's plot.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: A quest challenges Seong-jae to turn his rival, Sergeant Kim Kwan-cheol, into an ally.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Seong-jae navigates rising tensions and a sudden offer to join the officer's mess.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Seong-jae enters the officer's mess and completes a crucial quest.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Seong-jae begins his final quest and participates in a cooking competition.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: Seong-jae teams up with Sergeant Yoon and Sergeant Kim, as they go head-to-head with Lee Ho-young.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: As Seong-jae emerges as the contest winner, a brand new quest comes to light, challenging his skills once again.

series.name: If Wishes Could Kill
aka: กีรีโก: แอปหลอน พรสั่งตาย
गिरिगो - जब मांगो मौत की दुआ
กีรีโก แอปหลอน พรสั่งตาย
series.overview: Une mystérieuse application promet d'exaucer des vœux — avant de déclencher un compte à rebours vers la mort. Un groupe d'ados pris au piège doit briser l'engrenage pour survivre.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Quand Girigo exauce son vœu, Choi Hyeong-wook décide de montrer l'application à ses amis, qui refusent de le prendre au sérieux. Mais très vite, son comportement devient troublant.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Après une terrible tragédie, Se-ah craint que Kim Geon-woo ne soit le prochain, et rallie ses amis pour trouver une solution... mais Girigo semble hors de contrôle.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Afin de chasser le mal, Kang Ha-joon conduit Se-ah chez sa sœur chamane, où elle se retrouve prisonnière d'un lieu maudit, empreint de peur, de souffrance et d'abandon.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: En enquêtant sur les origines de Girigo, Ha-joon, Se-ah et Bangwool remontent la piste d'un ami de Hyeong-wook et découvrent une maison qui pourrait abriter des indices.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Après une soirée mouvementée, Lim Na-ri se heurte à une vérité terrifiante. Très vite, la jalousie la submerge alors qu'elle tente de comprendre ses sentiments pour Geon-woo.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: L'amitié innocente entre Kwon Si-won et Do Hye-ryung se teinte peu à peu de jalousie, de ressentiment et de vengeance... jusqu'à donner naissance à Girigo et à la malédiction.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Malgré le sabotage des esprits, la bande part à la recherche du téléphone originel. Mais alors qu'ils se rapprochent de leur but, danger et obscurité rôdent à chaque coin de rue.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Dos au mur, Se-ah confronte le mal à l'origine de la malédiction. Sera-t-elle capable de mettre fin à cette spirale destructrice une bonne fois pour toutes ?

series.name: Filing for Love
aka: ยื่นคำร้องฉบับเลิฟ
series.overview: Noh Ki-jun s'impose comme la figure de proue de l'équipe d'audit interne, notamment après avoir mis au jour une affaire de corruption au sein de la direction. Cependant, son ascension tant attendue se transforme en chute libre lorsque l'énigmatique et redoutable Joo In-ah, la nouvelle responsable des audits le rétrograde. Alors qu'il reçoit une information anonymes à propos d'une liaison de sa supérieure, il décide d'enquêter.

episodes.name: Up & Down
episodes.overview: In-a demotes Ki-jun as she becomes the new Director of the Audit Office at HAEMU GROUP.

episodes.name: I Am The Best
episodes.overview: Ki-jun's first case takes a dark turn and escalates into a sudden raid.

episodes.name: A Woman With A Twist
episodes.overview: With incriminating evidence in hand, Ki-jun plots his revenge against In-a.

episodes.name: Playing With Fire
episodes.overview: Things get complicated as Ki-jun and In-a go on a business trip together.

episodes.name: Heart Burn
episodes.overview: An unspoken tension takes a toll on In-a and Ki-jun's professional relationship.

episodes.name: Can’t You
episodes.overview: Ki-jun and In-a join forces to investigate a suspicious accident.

episodes.name: To Her Lover
episodes.overview: An anonymous report regarding Jae-yeol comes to light.

episodes.name: Desire & Hope
episodes.overview: Ki-jun uncovers the truth about Jae-yeol and In-a's past.

episodes.name: Love Dive
episodes.overview: Ki-jun and In-a begin an under-the-radar office romance.

episodes.name: Irreversible
episodes.overview: As In-a's past comes back to haunt her, Ki-jun steps in to protect her.

episodes.name: Hot Issue
episodes.overview: Ki-jun finds himself dragged back into a previous investigation.

episodes.name: Because I Love You
episodes.overview: With the fate of the company at stake, Ki-jun and In-a's relationship hangs in the balance.

series.name: Phantom Lawyer
aka: คู่หูทนาย คลายคดีวิญญาณ
シン・イラン法律事務所 〜真実は、あの世からやってくる！？～
Văn Phòng Luật Sư Shin Rang
series.overview: Un avocat timide qui se met soudainement à voir les fantômes fait équipe avec un avocat d'élite au caractère froid, et ensemble, ils prennent en charge des clients surnaturels dont les affaires inachevées révèlent des vérités enfouies.

episodes.name: A Haunted Law Office
episodes.overview: Rejected by law firms, Shin I-rang rents an eerie old office and lands his first job: a medical malpractice case for a ghost and his grieving wife.

episodes.name: An Unholy Alliance
episodes.overview: After ghostly client Lee Gang-pung possesses him, I-rang reconsiders their arrangement — until a crisis renews his conviction.

episodes.name: Death Of High School Girl
episodes.overview: The ghost of a teenage girl haunts I-rang in his office, demanding he acknowledge her existence and find out who she was.

episodes.name: Harmony of the Dead
episodes.overview: I-rang vows to reveal the true perpetrator behind Su-a's case. With this in mind, he enters a temporary alliance with his lawyer nemesis, Na-hyun.

episodes.name: Guilty Or Innocent?
episodes.overview: I-rang's new case involves a gifted scientist who died at the hands of his wife. The wife's defense lawyer turns out to be none other than Na-hyun.

episodes.name: New Suspect
episodes.overview: Mistakenly linked to a murder, I-rang must race against time to solve the case and prove his innocence.

episodes.name: Na-hyun's Past
episodes.overview: When I-rang loses his ability to see ghosts and Na-hyun suffers a career setback, the two cross paths again at the courthouse.

episodes.name: I-rang Meets So-hyun
episodes.overview: A possessed I-rang acts out at a crime scene and gets arrested. While locked up, he discovers the identity of the ghost who caused his outburst.

episodes.name: Na-hyun's Family
episodes.overview: Na-hyun spends precious time with her sister thanks to I-rang. But her emotional wounds deepen behind the facade of a happy family reunion.

episodes.name: The Secret Of I-rang's Old Friend
episodes.overview: I-rang and Na-hyun officially launch their partnership. On their first day, a vegetable vendor arrives at their office seeking legal help.

episodes.name: Seon-hwa's Past
episodes.overview: Attorney Yang Do-kyung complicates Na-hyun's case. I-rang and his partner bond and uncover crucial evidence that couldturn the trial in their favor.

episodes.name: The Missing Child
episodes.overview: I-rang discovers the tragic truth behind a child's death. Meanwhile, Do-kyung seethes with jealousy as he realizes Na-hyun's heart belongs to another.

episodes.name: The Truth Revealed
episodes.overview: After a violent encounter leaves I-rang in a critical state, a desperate Na-hyun confesses a secret as she stands by his side.

episodes.name: The Past Of My Father
episodes.overview: The ghost of I-rang's father appears, unaware of the heartache he caused his son. Can they find a way to overcome their painful past?

episodes.name: The Truth Of Gi-jung's Death
episodes.overview: As l-rang learns a shocking truth from his father, Do-kyung adds pressure and pushes him toward a breaking point.

episodes.name: The Final Confrontation
episodes.overview: To solve his father's case, I-rang secures a key piece of evidence. But when a new threat jeopardizes his findings, he makes a dangerous gamble.

series.name: My Royal Nemesis
aka: Kẻ Thù Hoàng Gia Của Tôi
ศัตรูหัวใจ นางร้ายวังหลวง
Mi némesis con aires de realeza
series.overview: Condamnée à mourir à l'ère Joseon, une méchante se réveille dans le Séoul moderne et rencontre un héritier sans pitié qui pourrait être sa dernière chance de réécrire son destin.

episodes.name: L'Enchanteresse et la Bête
episodes.overview: Condamnée à mort par empoisonnement, la concubine royale Kang Dan-sim voit sa vie s'achever avant de se réveiller dans un tout autre monde : celui de la Corée d'aujourd'hui.

episodes.name: Un guide pour optimiser son destin
episodes.overview: Dan-sim essaie de s'adapter à son nouvel environnement, mais son comportement étrange attire l'attention de Cha Se-gye, un riche héritier… qui lui fait alors une proposition.

episodes.name: Une toute nouvelle réalité
episodes.overview: Se-gye se rend compte qu'il ne peut s'empêcher de penser à Shin Seo-ri, surtout lorsqu'un rêve étrange fait naître en lui des sentiments inhabituels.

episodes.name: Au-delà de l'entendement
episodes.overview: Dan-sim en apprend davantage sur le passé de Seo-ri. Alors qu'elle passe plus de temps avec Se-gye, des signaux dissonants les poussent à mettre leurs sentiments à l'épreuve.

episodes.name: Le Fruit défendu
episodes.overview: Troublé par le comportement de Seo-ri, Se-gye met tout en œuvre pour conquérir son cœur. Seo-ri doit quant à elle gérer une partenaire agaçante et des tensions sur le plateau.

episodes.name: Une nuit de magie
episodes.overview: Seo-ri et Se-gye s'envolent pour Jeju, mais Se-gye se retrouve dans une situation d'urgence. Plus tard, Seo-ri disparaît et Se-gye, fou d'inquiétude, part à sa recherche.

episodes.name: La face cachée de la lune
episodes.overview: Les sentiments de Seo-ri envers Se-gye grandissent, mais sont remis en question quand Mo Tae-hee revendique également Se-gye. Soudainement, Se-gye a des ennuis.

episodes.name: Au diable ce monde
episodes.overview: Tae-hee annonce ses fiançailles à Se-gye à la presse, irritant Se-gye et alimentant la jalousie de Seo-ri. Choi Mun-do menace Seo-ri avec une demande.

episodes.name: Un premier amour
episodes.overview: Se-gye affronte Seo-ri au sujet de son identité – qui est Dan-sim? Seo-ri doit faire face à son passé et prendre une décision quant à sa relation avec Se-gye.

episodes.name: Espoir, désespoir et désir
episodes.overview: Le lien entre Seo-ri et Dan-sim est révélé. Se-gye et Dan-sim officialisent leur relation. Un Mun-do furieux prend des mesures extrêmes pour se venger.

episodes.name: Sur le chemin caché
episodes.overview: Dan-sim se réveille à l'époque Joseon et cherche à regagner le présent, pendant que Se-gye subit les retombées des manigances de Mun-do.

episodes.name: Rattraper le temps perdu
episodes.overview: Les univers de Dan-sim et Seo-ri s'entrechoquent. Se-gye emmène Dan-sim chez quelqu'un qui lui est cher, et elle lui avoue qu'il ne leur reste plus beaucoup de temps.

episodes.name: Coup du sort
episodes.overview: La santé de la grand-mère de Seo-ri se détériore. Plus tard, Dan-sim fait face à un cruel ultimatum... qui met en péril son avenir avec Se-gye.

episodes.name: My Royal Nemesis
episodes.overview: La décision de Dan-sim la renvoie à l'époque Joseon, tandis que Se-gye reste seul et inconsolable dans le monde moderne. Le destin leur permettra-t-il de se retrouver malgré tout?

series.name: Azure Spring
aka: คลื่นสีคราม
series.overview: Deux personnes enlisées dans leur vie se lancent dans la plongée haenyeo, trouvant guérison et nouveau sens dans la mer alors qu'elles affrontent ensemble leur passé et leurs peurs.

episodes.name: Make It Or Break It
episodes.overview: After injury and setbacks, former swimmer Anna returns to her hometown. Sharing a home with the unfamiliar Deok-hyun and reconnecting with an old friend, she finds her once-stalled life quietly beginning to move again.

episodes.name: Troublemaker Cat
episodes.overview: Anna sets out to learn diving from Deok-hyun, a Diver. As she confronts the sea's unforgiving nature, she's pushed beyond her limits. Amid the struggle, a subtle new rhythm begins to form between them, growing with each challenge they face together.

episodes.name: The Timing
episodes.overview: The diving lessons begin in earnest, and though still clumsy, Anna pushes forward one step at a time. As she struggles to find her rhythm in the water, Deok-hyun guides her with a quiet, steady presence, seemingly indifferent yet gently attentive. Between them, an unspoken shift begins to surface, and the air around them starts to feel just a little different.

episodes.name: Secret Of The Deep Sea
episodes.overview: Back in her hometown, the afterglow of Anna's first dive still lingers in the air. As she and Deok-hyun grow closer through shared time in the sea, an unexpected sense of comfort begins to form between them. But just as things start to settle, unsettling rumors about Deok-hyun resurface, quietly disrupting the calm rhythm of their once peaceful days.

episodes.name: How To Determine The End
episodes.overview: Anna uncovers a secret that should never surface, while Deok-hyun is forced to face a past he can no longer turn away from. As they confront their own limits, both are tested on whether they can find the courage to begin again.

episodes.name: Azure Spring
episodes.overview: Despite a typhoon and a canceled competition, Anna and Deok-hyun continue forward with their friends, refusing to give up. On the ever-changing sea, where nothing can be predicted, each of them is forced to face their own limits and find a way to move forward again in their own way.

series.name: Reverse
aka: จิตไม่ลืมแค้น

episodes.name: The Accident
episodes.overview: Myo Jin loses all her memories due to a major traffic accident. She can’t remember what caused the accident, where she lives, or even the name of her fiancé, Jun Ho. Sometimes fragments of memory come back, and she even sees someone burning. In the end, Myo Jin announces that she’s done waiting for her memories to return.

episodes.name: Distrust
episodes.overview: Myo Jin sees the initial “H” on a painting hanging on the wall and is reminded of Hee Soo. She immediately sets out to find Hee Soo and discovers that the two of them were very close. When she asks Jun Ho what kind of friend Hee Soo was, he somehow avoids giving a clear answer. Meanwhile, Jun Ho has Ria stay at the house to keep an eye on Myo Jin.

episodes.name: The Chase
episodes.overview: Myo Jin recalls how she first met Jun Ho and realises she has inflicted an irreparable wound on Hee Soo and that Jun Ho lied to her. Sang Ho tracks Lee Jong Su down. Myo Jin follows Lee Jong Su with Sang Ho to figure out what he has on Hee Soo. She finds out the shocking truth.

episodes.name: Caught
episodes.overview: After going through Lee Jong Su’s phone, Myo Jin realises he wasn’t just after Hee Soo’s money. Myo Jin meets Wang Gi Cheol in person and asks him to tell her what he knows about her. Gi Cheol shares what happened to Myo Jin’s parents and why he was sent to prison.

episodes.name: Kidnapping
episodes.overview: Myo Jin gets kidnapped, but Jun Ho manages to bring her home safely. Gi Cheol finds out that he has terminal pancreatic cancer and that he only has three months to live. Woo Sik brings the guys who kidnapped him to Myo Jin and Jun Ho’s house, so that they can get the money they want from Ria and Jun Ho. Meanwhile, Sang Ho goes to meet Lee Jong Ju at the hospital.

episodes.name: Descent Into Darkness
episodes.overview: After overhearing Ria’s phone call with Jun Ho, Myo Jin runs away from home. Jun Ho tells CEO Oh that he dropped out of the competition out of conscience as an architect, but CEO Oh doesn’t believe him. Meanwhile, Jun Ho learns from his doctor friend that Myo Jin is getting better fast, but Jun Ho stops his friend from giving Myo Jin any better treatment.

episodes.name: The Hunt
episodes.overview: Detective Woo finds an important piece of evidence regarding the villa murder case. Myo Jin regains her memory and realises who killed her parents. Details about what happened on the day Myo Jin’s parents passed away come to light. Meanwhile, Gi Cheol decides to end things for Myo Jin.

episodes.name: The Revenge
episodes.overview: Myo Jin learns that memories are part of the past and that you can’t change what’s already happened. She learns that the memory will haunt her until the day she dies, but she executes her plans nonetheless. Despite her mixed feelings toward Hee Soo, she carries out her revenge.

series.name: Gold Land
aka: แผนล่าท้าคนโลภ
series.overview: Une jeune femme travaillant comme agent de sécurité dans un aéroport se retrouve accidentellement en possession des lingots d'or d'un réseau de contrebande. Prise dans un tourbillon chaotique de cupidité et de trahison entre les différentes parties qui se disputent l'or, elle est consumée par le désir de s'approprier tout l'or.

episodes.name: Betting
episodes.overview: Customs officer Hee-ju agrees to help her pilot boyfriend Do-kyung with a suspicious deal.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Hiding in the one place she swore she'd never return, Hee-ju guards the gold from her pursuers.

episodes.name: Partnership
episodes.overview: Woogy makes Hee-ju an offer she can’t refuse, as Director Park steps up his search for the gold.

episodes.name: Him
episodes.overview: Sun-ok takes the fall for Hee-ju’s crime. In return, Hee-ju prepares one final surprise for her.

episodes.name: Secret
episodes.overview: Hee-ju joins forces with Woogy but doesn't trust him. As the others close in, Hee-ju stands alone.

episodes.name: Fissure
episodes.overview: The owner of the gold bars returns and Director Park spirals out of control.

episodes.name: Villains
episodes.overview: Hee-ju doesn't hide her desire for the gold, and Jin-man learns an unexpected truth.

episodes.name: Choice
episodes.overview: Jin-man is shocked and confused after discovering Hee-ju's identity and Woogy finds himself in danger.

episodes.name: Consequences
episodes.overview: Jin-man makes a bold move and Do-kyung goes to see Hee-ju.

episodes.name: Gold Land
episodes.overview: Everyone chasing the gold finally arrives in the same place.

series.name: We Are All Trying Here
aka: 誰だって無価値な自分と闘っている
เราต่างพยายามสุดใจ
Каждый борется со своей собственной никчёмностью
series.overview: Un réalisateur, qui cherche en vain à percer depuis 20 ans, touche le fond… jusqu'au jour où il rencontre une productrice débordée qui l'aide à retrouver l'estime de soi.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: After 20 years trying to make his debut film, Hwang Dong-man flails through life, irritating his director friends — until one day he meets Byeon Eun-a.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: While Dong-man deals with rock bottom, Ko Hye-jin delivers devastating news. Meanwhile, Eun-a seeks counseling as she struggles at work.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Dong-man slowly grows closer to Eun-a. Later, he makes an enemy of Park Gyeong-se — whose film opens to negative critical reception.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Gyeong-se sets his revenge against Dong-man in motion — playing dirty. Meanwhile, Eun-a faces mounting hostility and pressure at work.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Tired of enduring contempt from his peers, Dong-man confronts Gyeong-se. He later chastises Ma Jae-yeong over his relationship with Eun-a.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Dong-man rushes to share a meal with Eun-a — but is met with a surprise. Later, Eun-a receives a phone call that stops her in her tracks.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: As Dong-man and Eun-a's bond deepens, they both make decisions about their scripts. Eun-a and Oh Jeong-hui finally come face-to-face in a tense moment.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: When Dong-man learns that Jae-yeong is about to begin filming, he becomes consumed by envy. Meanwhile, Eun-a decides to confront Jeong-hui directly.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Just as Dong-man is about to debut, his fears haunt him — but Eun-a offers her brand of support. Meanwhile, Eun-a's secret script garners interest.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Desperate to cast Noh Kang-sik, Dong-man takes matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Eun-a grows uneasy as Jeong-hui involves herself in her project.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: An envious man seeks inner peace while feeling isolated in a world where others seem to always succeed.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: Eun-a takes a bold step forward in resilience. As Dong-man grows increasingly impatient with production timing, will he finally release his film?

episodes.name: The Worst Encounter and the Best Trap

series.name: That Genius is Attached to His Fake Girlfriend
series.original_name: その天才様は偽装彼女に執着する
aka: That Genius is Attached to His Fake Girlfriend
那位天才对伪装女友过分执着
その天才様は偽装彼女に執着する
series.overview: À l'aube de ses 30 ans, Rin Hoshino, une « jeune fille gentille mais malchanceuse qui prend soin des autres », touche le fond : elle n'a ni emploi ni petit ami. Grâce à son frère aîné, elle commence à travailler comme femme de ménage chez Iku Wakatsuki, un programmeur de génie. Cependant, la personne dont elle a la charge n’est autre que ce « homme mystérieusement insensible » qui avait autrefois ruiné ses chances de se marier. Bien que leur relation commence par les pires retrouvailles possibles, le contrat de ménage finit par inclure également un « contrat de partenaire amoureux »… Une histoire d’amour tendre, empreinte d’une forte possessivité, menée par un « génie » maladroit, commence !

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Burnt out and suddenly jobless, Midori joins her borther at their late grandmother's seaside villa, where they meet its mysterious caretaker, Nishigami.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Midori and Konta's friends arrive at the vacation home. The group is excited when Nishigami appears — but a tarot card gives an ominous reading.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: A veteran actor suddenly arrives, explaining that Konta helped him escape the media after a four-way cheating scandal blew up in his face.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Konta's special booze throws the party into chaos. But when he comes home with a stranger the next morning, Midori and the others welcome him in.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Jin's wife Ryoko suddenly shows up. What seems like a showdown takes an unexpected turn, leaving Midori and her friends inspired to pursue romance.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Amid a rush of wedding announcements, Midori, Rinrin and Tsumugi feel the pressure. As they watch a dating show, the villa's doorbell rings.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: The girls are thrilled when three handsome men appear, but the guys only talk about startups and seminars — until their true motive is revealed.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: As the guys' true colors come to light and an incident occurs, Nishigami steps in, sending Midori's heart aflutter. A video of Konta draws attention.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Konta lands a documentary feature but initially hesitates to accept. Once filming begins, however, his overzealous enthusiasm gets the better of him.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: As filming winds down and Midori and friends grow fed up with Konta's big-shot antics, Torihara says he has enough footage and packs up early.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: The documentary casts Konta in a surprising light, leaving him devastated. He shuts himself away, but the broadcast sparks an unexpected miracle.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: A priest visits the villa to change everyone's lazy ways. Following his teachings, they prepare to welcome their late grandmother back for Obon.

episodes.name: Épisode 13
episodes.overview: Midori thanks her late grandmother for the villa. When Nishigami warns Nobuko's ghost that her grandkids are fated to die, she fights to save them.

episodes.name: Épisode 14
episodes.overview: Nishigami bonds with Midori as romance blooms around the villa. As his attachment to the humans deepens, he faces pressure from the underworld.

episodes.name: Épisode 15
episodes.overview: When Nishigami stops visiting, Midori seeks him out but is coldly rejected, sparking a huge fight. They make up, but their troubles aren't over yet.

series.name: My Cold Coworker Obsessively Loves Me
series.original_name: ドライな同期の溺愛癖
aka: My Cold Coworker Obsessively Loves Me
ドライな同期の溺愛癖

series.name: The Night I Got Pregnant By the CEO
series.original_name: あの夜、社長の子供を授かりました
aka: 那一夜，我怀了社长的孩子
The Night I Got Pregnant By the CEO
那一夜，我懷上了社長的孩子
Ano Yoru, Shacho no Kodomo wo Sazukarimashita
あの夜、社長の子供を授かりました
series.overview: Hanai Shiori travaille dans la même entreprise de vente de vêtements en ligne que son petit ami, Yoshino Keiichi. Mais le jour de leur troisième anniversaire, elle découvre qu'il l'a trompée. Le cœur brisé, elle part noyer son chagrin et finit par s'évanouir dans un bar. L'homme qu'elle rencontre l'emmène à l'hôtel pour qu'elle se repose, mais alors qu'il s'apprête à partir, Shiori le retient. Touchée par sa sincérité, elle lui demande de passer la nuit avec elle. Elle pensait ne plus jamais le revoir, mais par un cruel coup du sort, il est le nouveau PDG de l'entreprise. De plus, Shiori découvre qu'elle est enceinte.

series.name: Let's End Our Friendship Now
series.original_name: 今から、親友やめようか。
aka: ¿Y si dejamos de ser mejores amigos a partir de ahora?
从现在开始，不做朋友了吧。
今から、親友やめようか。

series.name: Whether or Not
series.original_name: できても、できなくても
aka: できても、できなくても

series.name: Until the T-Shirt Dries
aka: ก่อนความสุขจะจางหาย
Hasta que la camiseta se seque

episodes.name: Until I Found Out the Secret.
episodes.overview: A sudden accident shatters the everyday happiness two couples had always taken for granted — and exposes a secret one of them kept hidden for years.

episodes.name: The Smell of the Third Friday
episodes.overview: Itsuki reveals he saw Azusa and Mitsuru together on "the third Friday." Sakiko wants to believe her husband, but begins investigating their secret.

episodes.name: What I'm Not Good At
episodes.overview: As their investigation stalls, Sakiko and Itsuki bond over shared frustration. A call from the police leads them to retrace Mitsuru and Azusa's steps.

episodes.name: Poor Man
episodes.overview: The discovery of two sets of tickets forces Sakiko and Itsuki to confront the possibility of an affair. Sakiko then finds a new clue on Mitsuru's phone.

episodes.name: If You Don't Bother Anyone
episodes.overview: Sakiko follows Mitsuru's trail all the way to Nagano, while an unexpected guest from Azusa's childhood pays Itsuki a visit.

episodes.name: What's the Evidence?
episodes.overview: A sudden return brings Sakiko, Itsuki and a familiar face together for the first time. As truths emerge, Sakiko reflects on her life with Mitsuru.

episodes.name: Meet On the Third Friday
episodes.overview: A familiar face challenges Sakiko and Itsuki to define their relationship, as the truth about Mitsuru and Azusa's third Friday meetings unravels.

episodes.name: Escape and Snooping
episodes.overview: Sakiko doesn't return after learning the truth. Worried, Mitsuru gathers her friends at a café, hoping to learn more about the side of her he never knew.

episodes.name: What I Couldn't Say
episodes.overview: Sakiko enjoys time with a man and his children by the sea, while a troubled Mitsuru learns his wife was a very different person before they met.

episodes.name: The Unnamed Relationship
episodes.overview: Mitsuru treads carefully, but Sakiko's fears of losing him again take over. She opens up to Itsuki as all three choose the paths their lives will take.

series.name: 25 Years of You
aka: คำสารภาพที่รอ 25 ปี
Lời Thú Nhận: Bí Mật 25 Năm
series.overview: L'obsession inavouée d'un homme pour une femme depuis 25 ans finit par révéler la vérité sur un événement violent survenu pendant leur enfance.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Shy office worker Sota steps in to help his colleague Mariko after her father, the head of their company, derails her plans for a new skin care division.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: After transferring to Mariko's department, Sota uncovers evidence that an embittered executive has been plotting against her and stealing company funds.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Estranged from her father, Mariko dreads her upcoming birthday celebration at their family home; Sota devises a pretext to join the party.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Sota begins to suspect Ginjiro was involved in Mariko's attempted kidnapping 25 years ago and secretly searches the Nose Cosmetics office for clues.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Sota confronts Sayuri over her sinister plans for her stepdaughter; Mariko begins to feel like she and Sota may have met long ago.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Mariko discovers Sota has secretly been nearby all along. Suspecting Sota of murder, Taisuke finds a crucial clue to the killer’s identity.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Mariko is unnerved to learn Sota has secretly followed her on social media for years; Taisuke seems intent on casting suspicion upon Sota.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Driven by curiosity, Mariko secretly investigates Sota after work. Later, troubling news about her stepmother emerges, putting her well-being at risk.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Mariko learns Sota has secretly protected her since the incident 25 years ago, prompting her to make a drastic decision that changes everything.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: After 25 long years of harboring secret affection for Mariko, the time has finally come for Sota to step up and save her from danger.

series.name: Viral Hit
aka: นักสู้ทูปเบอร์
series.overview: Après avoir accidentellement fait le buzz à la suite d'une bagarre, un ado pauvre et harcelé lance une chaîne de streaming pour se faire de l'argent et échapper au désespoir.

episodes.name: Do You Want to Become Stronger?
episodes.overview: Shimura endures daily torment from school tyrant Hamaken. But his luck changes when a scuffle with bootlicker Kanegon accidentally goes live — and viral.

episodes.name: Fan the Flames of Anger
episodes.overview: Mugged by delinquents, Shimura follows TOU-KEI's teachings to fight back. Later, despite landing a blow on Hamaken, Shimura lands in even deeper trouble.

episodes.name: I'm Not a Loser!
episodes.overview: Humiliated in front of his crush, Shimura disappears. As everyone searches desperately for him, Kanegon endures brutal violence from Hamaken.

episodes.name: Well Then, My Friend
episodes.overview: Viral Hit faces its first crisis and Shimura must take on multiple opponents. Later, ex-taekwondo champ Shinjo targets them and attacks Kanegon.

episodes.name: The Original Viral Hit
episodes.overview: The Shimura vs. Shinjo fight reaches a shocking conclusion. Viral Hit reaches 1M subscribers, and the head of BAD FELLOWS approaches with a proposition.

episodes.name: This is My Youth
episodes.overview: As the final battle nears, Shimura's group face mounting challenges. TOU-KEI's secret emerges and their last fight begins — for friends, family and love.

series.name: I Will Be Your Bloom
aka: ขอให้ฝันได้ผลิบาน

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Former teacher Asuka takes a job as the dorm parent for a struggling group of young entertainers — one of whom used to be a student of hers.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Asuka resolves to gain more fans for 8LOOM. Meanwhile, the boys grow restless as they face the daunting challenge of securing a contract renewal.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: As part of her strategy to make the 8LOOM members more self-reliant, newly appointed chief manager Kosaka declares that Asuka is no longer needed.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Hanamaki tells Dan to write a love song, but he's never written one before. Asuka goes on a mock date with him and learns about his complex feelings.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: The boys get the chance to have a live performance broadcast on TV. But the day before the show, they learn that Takara has been hiding an injury.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: As 8LOOM's popularity grows, the group books a performance at Dan's old high school. Eiji gets angry when Yukiya invites a former member to the show.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Dan and the boys plan a surprise for Asuka to show their appreciation for her. Later, they learn why she decided to quit her teaching job.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: The 8LOOM members are thrilled to learn they will play their first nationwide tour. Dan asks an insecure Naru to direct the group's music video.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: When Dan refuses to apologize to 8LOOM's fans, Hanamaki tells him to take a break from the group. Later, rifts begin to form between the members.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Asuka begins working as a dorm manager and teacher at an alternative school. Meanwhile, the boys make a difficult decision about their future.

series.name: TAGUSARI bros.
aka: สองพี่น้องทากุซาริ ไขปมคดีปริศนา
series.overview: Deux frères rejoignent la police pour élucider le meurtre de leurs parents, car l'affaire est sur le point d'expirer quelques jours avant que le Japon n'abolisse la prescription.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Makoto Tagusari, a determined detective, and his younger brother Minoru, a forensic medical examiner, are bound by a tragic past—the brutal murder of their parents years earlier; as the statute of limitations on the case expires just days before its abolition, the brothers are left without justice, pushing them to pursue the truth on their own while working within the system, as the first episode sets the stage for their quest to uncover the culprit behind the long-unsolved family murder.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Haruko’s investigation into a specific murder case uncovers that the victim was living under a false identity, which shifts the motive toward a potential revenge killing. This revelation complicates the case for the Tagusari brothers as they track the suspect, Nogami, leading to a series of shocking truths about the victim's past.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: The brothers find their parents' suspected killer comatose in a hospital.  As they investigate an arson-murder case, Minoru uncovers key evidence.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Makoto and Minoru find a key and a cryptic note among Tsuda's belongings. Meanwhile, the hunt for a fugitive takes a grim and unexpected turn.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: A hidden handgun leaves Makoto and Minoru facing difficult questions, and a bizarre confession leads police into an increasingly baffling investigation.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: The handgun leads Makoto and Minoru to their father's factory — and a possible link to the yakuza. A fatal car accident reveals foul play.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Minoru investigates a suspicious death and hunts for Tsuda's missing notebook as Makoto's ties to a city welfare counselor raise red flags.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Makoto and Minoru restore Tsuda's notebook, but Koike seizes it. Makoto confronts him — and the identity of their parents' killer begins to surface.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: After a shocking discovery, the Karashimas flee and a devastated Minoru shuts down. Makoto steps up to track them, suspecting someone aided their escape.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: The truth behind their parents' 31-year-old murder is finally revealed — but as Minoru reaches a breaking point, the brothers face an impossible choice.

series.name: Straight to Hell
aka: หมอดูดวงนรก
series.overview: Qui était vraiment Kazuko Hosoki, voyante la plus célèbre du Japon et figure incontournable de la télévision et de l'édition, soupçonnée d'escroquerie et de liens avec la pègre ?

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: La romancière Minori rencontre Kazuko, voyante star de la TV à l'origine du fameux "vous irez tout droit en enfer", et s'intéresse aux rumeurs qui entourent son succès fulgurant.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Refusant d'être plus longtemps exploitée, Kazuko ouvre son propre commerce et dégage rapidement assez de bénéfices pour ouvrir un club à Ginza, le quartier le plus sélect de Tokyo.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Kazuko se retrouve piégée et étouffée par le carcan d'un mariage traditionnel. De retour à Tokyo, ses affaires ont du succès, et les yakuzas ne tardent pas à lui rendre visite.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Dans un Tokyo en pleine effervescence olympique, et alors que ses clubs prospèrent, Kazuko est séduite par Sudo et prend une décision impulsive qui risque de lui coûter cher.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Dans le présent, Minori interroge Kazuko sur ses pratiques commerciales douteuses et le regrette amèrement. En 1970, Kazuko s'enfonce un peu plus dans la violence et la peur.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Le choc pétrolier de 1973 met le club de Kazuko en difficulté, mais une rencontre avec une voyante change la donne et l'encourage à essayer quelque chose de nouveau.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Kazuko tisse un récit émouvant sur la manière dont elle a sauvé la vie et la carrière de Chiyoko Shimakura, mais une figure de son passé dévoile une autre version de l'histoire.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Après une trahison dévastatrice, Kazuko se réinvente en devenant voyante. Habitée par une insatiable soif de pouvoir, elle utilise ses relations pour bâtir un empire médiatique.

episodes.name: Épisode final
episodes.overview: Au vu de nouvelles révélations, Minori tente de démêler le vrai du faux derrière le mythe créé par Kazuko, qui ne cesse d'interférer. Quelle histoire choisira-t-elle de raconter ?

series.name: kiDnap GAME
aka: キッドナップ ゲーム

cast.name: นฤภรกมล ฉายแสง

episodes.name: Mysterious Message
episodes.overview: Detective Toshiro Niide is a straightforward man with a strong sense of justice. To arrest a criminal, he disregards danger and sometimes acts in ways that seem reckless. Whenever he is on the verge of being consumed by anger, he is guided by the words of his wife, Saori: "Show me kindness rather than anger. That is the right thing for you to do." Niide and six others whose loved ones have been taken, each receive a mysterious message on their phones: "You have been entered in the kiDnap GAME."

episodes.name: The Mission
episodes.overview: The game has finally begun. Toshiro Niide receives his mission: "Apprehend the mastermind behind the kidnappings." Determined to save Saori, Niide pursues the case on his own. Evading the Special Investigation Team (SIT), which has placed him under surveillance as a suspect, he gathers information from Sonomi Uemura, the owner of the food truck Saori frequents, and news reporter Akina Isobe. Yet the kidnappers' motives and objectives remain elusive.
